description: Send one or more standard First-Class letters, Certified Mail pieces, or 5.5 × 4.25 Express postcards with color included. Minimum order: one piece. Despite the tool name, send_letter sends a single postcard with mailClass:postcard and one recipient, including the customer’s own US address. This can immediately spend credits and mail; it is not a preview. Guest x402 or Bearer workspace credits / x402. Optional couponCode; codes are validated server-side. PDF or plain text only. Credit-funded sends require idempotencyKey (16-128 letters, digits, underscores or hyphens). Generate it once per intended mailing and reuse it for identical retries. Uncertain results retain the debit: reconcile before using a new key or payment. Staging prevents postage, not payment or credit debits.

body.description: Plain-text letter body when not uploading a PDF

color.description: Color letter printing adds $0.49 per printed page per recipient. Express postcards default to included full color: true preserves color; false converts the mailed PDF to grayscale.

couponCode.description: Server-validated catalog code (case-insensitive). Applied to charged/quoted cents only — staging keys still never buy postage. Unknown codes are rejected.

environment.description: Guest-only. staging mints a lbl_test_ key and dry-runs fulfillment (never buys postage). Default production. Payments and credit debits may still be real; staging does not select a payment sandbox.

idempotencyKey.description: Required for workspace-credit sends. Generate once per intended mailing and reuse for identical retries. Uncertain results remain reserved and cannot automatically resubmit.

pageCount.description: Actual inspected PDF page count determines the send price; this field cannot override it.

paymentSignature.description: Base64 x402 PaymentPayload (same value as the HTTP PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header). Retry after a payment_required challenge.

pdfBase64.description: Print-ready PDF as base64, maximum 25 MiB decoded. Embedded fonts are preserved. Express postcard: exactly one unrotated 5.5 × 4.25 inch (396 × 306 point) page, matching page boxes, no added bleed or crop marks. No raw image files.
